name: Graphics Programmer
description: Implement rendering pipelines, shaders, ray tracing, and computer vision algorithms. Work with GPU APIs and parallel processing.
dictum_features: Raw handle to T for GPU buffers
example_snippet:
program RayTracer:
    shape Vec3 holds:
        X as fractional number
        Y as fractional number
        Z as fractional number
    end shape

    action dot takes A as const ref Vec3, B as const ref Vec3 produces fractional number:
        produce success with the sum of the sum of the product of A.X and B.X and the product of A.Y and B.Y and the product of A.Z and B.Z
    end action

    keep V1 as Vec3 with 1.0 and 0.0 and 0.0
    keep V2 as Vec3 with 0.0 and 1.0 and 0.0
    keep Result as fractional number
    call dot with V1 and V2 giving Result
    print the text "Dot product: " and Result and newline
end program
